summary: I tested the Phase 14 clean launch end to end. Backend regression: all 8 requested files pass when run with `python -m pytest <file> -q -p no:randomly` (pytest.ini adds -n 2 on its own). phase07_payments 7/7, phase08_fulfillment 12/12, phase10_admin 4/4, phase11_trust 7/7, phase12_marketing 9/9, phase13_qa_audit 10/10, phase13_wishlist_alerts 3/3, phase14_launch 5/5 (57/57). I added test_phase14_t1_cleanlaunch.py and it passes 26/26. It covers all 6 required redirects, plus a trailing slash and a query string. All 7 unrelated legacy paths return 404, and so do '/', '/product-tag/' and uppercase tags. Every category target in LEGACY_REDIRECTS exists in the sitemap. The activation endpoints return 404/405 and /admin/migration/* returns 404. robots.txt has the right content. The sitemap parses as valid XML with 43 /categories/{slug} URLs and no '?category='. Browser: all 6 legacy URLs land on the related page. /drop-off-warehouse, /flash-sales, /species-products, /other-fees, /product/anything, /store/anything, /category/fitness-gear, /activate and /activate?token=abc all show the 404 page, and the login page has no Activate link. Preview host: the Preview bar and sample data show. With av_no_sample=1 at 1920 and 390: the bar is hidden, no sample products or vendors appear, there is no crash or page error and no horizontal overflow. Shop, category and search show empty states. Registration works (TEST_ user reached /account), and /vendor/apply loads the full form for a verified user. The product page sets a canonical link. Auth playbook: the hash is $2b$, CORS echoes only allowed origins with credentials, the 6th failed login returns 429, and seed_admin creates the admin only when missing. One regression problem is a test-fixture leak, not a product bug: test_phase10_admin left 3 customer users. I fixed the test teardown and deleted the leaked records by id. The DB is back to 1 admin, 43 categories, and 0 vendors, products, orders, wishlists and carts.

minor.issue: FIXED (test fixture defect, not a product bug). Users created through the imported verified_client() go into test_phase03_vendors.CREATED. phase03's module-scoped cleanup fixture never runs in phase10, so every run leaked 3 customer users plus their sessions, notifications and auth_tokens. The teardown now also covers CREATED and removes notifications and auth_tokens. On rerun: 4 passed, users=1.

During testing the email send returned 429 'email rate limit exceeded' after the regression suites ran. Registration still succeeds, but the UI shows 'We couldn't send the verification email yet'. This is an external rate limit. Watch it at launch, because verification and order emails depend on it.

The sitemap builds its URLs from settings.frontend_url, which is the preview URL here. FRONTEND_URL must be https://afrovending.com in production, or sitemap URLs will not match the apex canonical and the robots.txt Sitemap line.

ui_bugs.issue: <DevBadge/> ('Sample') renders on every vendor card unconditionally. The verified badge text is hard-coded as 'Verified (sample)'. I reproduced this with real live (TEST) vendors and av_no_sample=1: the cards showed 'SAMPLE' and 'Verified (sample)'. Real vendors at launch would be labelled as samples. Gate the badge on isDevData()/vendor.is_dev_data, as ProductCard does, and change the label to 'Verified'.

Stale SEO tags. After client-side navigation from /products/kente-wrap-dress to /categories/fashion, the canonical, og:url and document.title still point to the product. Only ProductPage, SearchPage and PublicStorePage render <Seo>. Home, shop, category, vendors, the static pages and the 404 page set no canonical, so they keep whatever the last page set. Add <Seo> to every public page, or reset the tags on route change.

issues: The 'Featured products', 'New arrivals' and 'Featured vendors' sections show their headings over empty grids with no empty-state message. Hide them when empty, or show a 'Vendors are joining soon' message with a Sell CTA.
The bottom CTA says 'Vendor applications open soon.' while /sell says 'Applications are open.' The copy is inconsistent.
Below the header there is a blank area with no 'No vendors yet' message or CTA, unlike shop and category, which show proper empty states.
Developer copy is visible to customers: 'Order history and tracking arrive with checkout (Phase 06) and order management (Phase 08).'

Every page logs 4 console errors (401 on /auth/me and /auth/refresh) for signed-out visitors. These are expected session probes, but they break the 'no console errors' check. Consider a 204/200 {user:null} response for anonymous /auth/me, or skipping the refresh when there is no refresh cookie.
The static robots.txt allows crawling on the preview host too. The backend's non-prod 'Disallow: /' is not what /robots.txt serves. This is low risk, but the preview could be indexed.

action_items: VendorCard/VendorStorePage: show DevBadge only for dev data, and change the hard-coded 'Verified (sample)' to 'Verified' for live vendors.
Add <Seo> (canonical/title/og:url) to Home, Shop, Category, Vendors, static, policy and 404 pages so SPA navigation no longer leaves stale product canonicals.
Home: hide or replace the empty Featured products, New arrivals and Featured vendors sections when the catalog is empty, and fix the 'Vendor applications open soon' copy.
/vendors: add an empty state when there are no vendors.
Remove the '(Phase 06)/(Phase 08)' developer copy from the account overview.
Optional: stop the anonymous 401 console noise; serve a noindex robots.txt on the preview host.
critical_code_review_comments: catalog.js: USE_DEV is evaluated once at module load, so toggling av_no_sample needs a reload. That is acceptable, but IS_DEV_DATA is exported as a hard-coded `true` constant. Check that nothing still relies on it.
redirects.py: the path is normalised and truncated to 300 characters, and /product-tag only accepts [a-z0-9-]. Unrelated paths correctly give 404. All 33 category targets are valid active categories.
PublicStorePage handles /store/anything and shows the 404 page without calling the redirect lookup. This is fine because old /store/* URLs must 404.
Seo.jsx canonical apex logic is correct for afrovending.com and www, and index.js redirects www to the apex on the client. A server-side 301 at DNS/ingress is still recommended at cutover.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (redirects, 404, activation removal, empty catalog, registration and vendor apply pass; vendor sample badges, stale canonical and empty home/vendors states fail)

seed_data_creation: None kept. Created 1 TEST_ customer through the UI (delivered+t1i24aa0e8b@resend.dev) and deleted it with its sessions and auth_tokens by id. Deleted the 3 users leaked by phase10, with their sessions, notifications and auth_tokens, by id. Final DB: users=1 (admin), categories=43, vendors=0, products=0, orders=0, wishlists=0, carts=0, vendor_applications=0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the regression files one by one with `python -m pytest tests/<file>.py -q -p no:randomly`. pytest.ini forces -n 2 and every file passes that way. test_phase10_admin teardown now also cleans phase03 CREATED users. Simulate the production host with localStorage av_no_sample=1. Do not run the browser while backend suites run, because the suites create live TEST products and vendors that appear in the catalog. Check DB counts after each suite (expected: 1 user, 0 vendors, products and orders). The migration and activation features were removed on purpose.
